property.name: name
property.value: Garden - Cave Entrance

property.name: text1_1
property.value: * (Welcome to the Cave Zone!)

property.name: text1_10
property.value: * (So,[wait:5] it's tricky.[wait:5] But I think it could be worth your while...!)

property.name: text1_2
property.value: * (Up ahead is a cave you can go into to find treasures galore!)

property.name: text1_3
property.value: * (Be warned though --[wait:5] it is quite dangerous,[wait:5] and there are some things to consider.)

property.name: text1_4
property.value: * (The cave consists of 5 SUBLEVELS.[wait:5] Each SUBLEVEL has [color:yellow]TREASURE [color:reset]and enemies.)

property.name: text1_5
property.value: * (You must bring the [color:yellow]TREASURE[color:reset] one at a time to me at the SUBLEVEL's starting zone.)

property.name: text1_6
property.value: * (Then,[wait:5] the entrance to the next SUBLEVEL opens.)

property.name: text1_7
property.value: * (Once you enter the cave,[wait:5] you cannot leave until you reach the EXIT at the end...)

property.name: text1_8
property.value: * (No healing items can be found in the cave...[wait:5] only what you come in with.)

property.name: text1_9
property.value: * (If you are DEFEATED,[wait:5] you'll go back to the starting zone of the SUBLEVEL.)

property.name: text1
property.value: * (A cave full of danger and glory awaits...)

property.name: text2
property.value: * (You are filled with the power of spelunking.)

property.name: text1_1
property.value: * (Welcome back!)

property.name: text1_2
property.value: * (Yeah the cave closed in on itself as we left)

property.name: text1_3
property.value: * (No clue why it did that,[wait:5] never seen that happen before in my entire caving career)

property.name: text1_4
property.value: * (Might have something to do with The Key...)

property.name: text1_5
property.value: * (But that's all for this zone.[wait:5] And don't worry, you got the money already.)

property.name: text2_1
property.value: * (Huh?[wait:5] You think that cave was brutal and unfair and had bad level design?)

property.name: text2_2
property.value: * (Heh.[sound:farmerlaugh][wait:5] You don't even know the half of it.)

property.name: text2_3
property.value: * (Come back when you've finished Kipkip 2.[wait:5] There you'll see some REAL Lands of Torture.)

property.name: text3_1
property.value: * (Good job in that cave.[wait:5] Usually we don't like foreigners but you're one of the good ones)

property.name: text3_2
property.value: * (Yeah we're lowkey crazy jingoist i'll admit.[wait:5] And super $$$$ing greedy)

property.name: text3_3
property.value: * (At least we're all the same color so nothing bad really happens with us as a whole)

property.name: text4_1
property.value: * (Except for those shamans though. They think they're $$$$ing above everyone)

property.name: text4_2
property.value: * (Just because you don't desire anything doesn't mean you're better than everyone else)

property.name: text5_1
property.value: * (Like that $#!! can't be good for you your skin is orange and your leaf is on fire)

property.name: text5_2
property.value: * (Like what are you doing.[wait:5] That isn't normal)

property.name: text6_1
property.value: * (I'd really hate to see what would happen if some of them decided to join the GARDNER.)

property.name: text6_2
property.value: * (With their superiority complex and their crazy power?[wait:5] PLUS the GARDNER's powers?)

property.name: text6_3
property.value: * (...[wait:5]you're going up against the GARDNER,[wait:5] right?)

property.name: text6_4
property.value: * (...Good luck.)

property.name: text7_1
property.value: * (...Good luck.)

property.name: text1
property.value: * (And so,[wait:5] your spelunking adventure has ended.)

property.name: text2
property.value: * (You are filled with the power of trauma.)
